literal_meaning: সাতের অর্ধেক বা সাড়ে সাত (শনির সাতাধিক বছরের প্রভাব)
figurative_meaning_en: A challenging astrological period influenced by Saturn, lasting seven and a half years, often bringing misfortunes or trials
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জীবনে এখন সাড়ে সাতির দশা চলছে, তাই সবকিছু বাধাগ্রস্ত হয়ে যাচ্ছে।
জ্যোতিষী বললেন, সাড়ে সাতি শেষ হলে জীবন স্বাভাবিক হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is currently going through Sade Sati, which is why everything seems to be going wrong.
The astrologer said that once the seven-and-a-half-year Saturn period ends, life will normalize.
history: In Hindu astrology (Jyotish Shastra), Sade Sati refers to the 7.5-year transit of Saturn over the Moon sign and adjacent houses, believed to cause hardships based on one's zodiac.
note: This idiom is derived from Vedic astrology and is widely used in Bengali Hindu communities to explain periods of adversity.
